$comment: Market benchmarks (spec §2.2). EMPTY BY DESIGN. A benchmark is a measurement over the anonymized document corpus described in §2.2 and §5.2 — it is produced by querying that corpus, not by an author writing a number. 23 authored percentages previously lived here; they were fabricated for the prototype and have been removed rather than quarantined, because unlike a clause there is no review that turns an invented percentage into a true one. Entries are populated by the corpus query job, and each must carry n, asOf, and query alongside the value before it can pass the release gate.
